verdict.rationale: Stripe documents virtual cards scoped to a single task or session that are automatically invalidated after use. Spending controls can restrict merchant IDs and categories and set per-authorization limits. Real-time authorization webhooks let you approve or decline each charge, for example against an expected merchant and amount. missing for 10: explicit documentation of exact-amount locking rather than a per-authorization cap, explicit merchant allow-listing (the evidence only describes blocking merchant IDs), more detail than a single sentence on single-use invalidation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
